newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Bank to provide aid to Nikko Sec affiliate.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Bank to provide aid to Nikko Sec affiliate.

text.p: Asahi Bank Ltd said on Tuesday it would provide 47.6 billion yen in financial aid to a non bank affiliated with Asahi and with Nikko Securities Co Ltd.
A bank spokesman said, however, that details of how it would give financial support to Kyodo Mortgage Acceptance (Kyodo Teito Shoken Co Ltd) had not yet been decided.

Nikko Securities announced earlier on Tuesday that it would provide 147.5 billion yen in financial aid to its three non-bank affiliates including Kyodo Mortgage Acceptance, which is half-owned by Asahi Bank.
Nikko said its aid to Kyodo Mortgage Acceptance would amount to 82.1 billion yen.
